verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security regression. The generated SPEC-REFERENCE assertions for SUBSTR start-before-one and ROUND(-0.5) remain live, the focused generator test locates and verifies their exact executable assertions, the self-expiring divergence tests still guard removal of the special cases, and the end-to-end fault injection makes the real nargo run fail if the circuit wiring is vacuous. The workflow pins both the Noir toolchain version and noir_XPath release tag, runs the cheap drift/unit-test half before installation, and accurately limits its claims to sampled witness-generation verification with the required research-grade/not-externally-audited caveat. No reviewer-directed or other prompt-injection text was detected in the diff.
